scripts.verify:prerender: bun -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const checksByFile = { 'dist/index.html': ['Everything in one workspace', 'Claude Agent', 'Every session, one view.', 'agents over ACP', '/hero/agents-hub.mp4', 'Project-Based Workspaces', 'Embedded Browser'], 'dist/privacy/index.html': ['Privacy — Wrangl', '>Privacy', /Last updated:(?:| )*[A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}/, 'no analytics', 'https://wrangl.dev/privacy/'], 'dist/terms/index.html': ['Terms — Wrangl', '>Terms', /Last updated:(?:| )*[A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4}/, 'MIT License', 'https://wrangl.dev/terms/'], 'dist/404.html': ['Page not found'] }; const missing = []; for (const [file, checks] of Object.entries(checksByFile)) { const html = fs.existsSync(file) ? fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8') : ''; for (const s of checks) if (s instanceof RegExp ? !s.test(html) : !html.includes(s)) missing.push(file + ': ' + s); } if (fs.existsSync('dist/404/index.html')) missing.push('dist/404/index.html must not exist (would serve /404 as 200)'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/_redirects')) missing.push('dist/_redirects must not exist (SPA catch-all would turn 404s into soft 404s)'); if (missing.length) { console.error('Prerender check failed:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); } console.log('Prerender check passed.');"
